title: DEPRECATED_variable declaration

lines.explanation: A variable declaration always begins with a type and ends with a semicolon.  here, the type is integer. variables are i and j.
The type is used to identify the kind of data that will be stored in the memory location associated with the variable being declared.
you can declare several variables of the same type by separating the names with a comma. here, the type is double. variables are a and b.
